claim: pkgs.testers.runNixOSTest is a helper that behaves exactly like the NixOS runTest but pins the nixpkgs package set of the caller and makes nixpkgs.* options read-only.
stance_target: An out-of-tree flake should use its own nixpkgs input's testers.runNixOSTest so the tested VM uses the flake's pinned nixpkgs
quoted_support: A helper function that behaves exactly like the NixOS runTest, except it also assigns this Nixpkgs package set as the pkgs of the test and makes the nixpkgs.* options read-only. If your test is part of the Nixpkgs repository, or if you need a more general entrypoint, see "Calling a test" in the NixOS manual.

claim: The documented in-tree invocation shape is pkgs.testers.runNixOSTest ({ lib, ... }: { name; nodes.machine = { pkgs, ... }: { environment.systemPackages = ...; }; testScript = ''machine.succeed("hello")''; }) and it returns a derivation with notable attributes nodes and driverInteractive.
stance_target: The test module shape for a CI gate: name + nodes.<hostname> NixOS modules + Python testScript
quoted_support: pkgs.testers.runNixOSTest ( { lib, ... }: { name = "hello"; nodes.machine = { pkgs, ... }: { environment.systemPackages = [ pkgs.hello ]; }; testScript = '' machine.succeed("hello") ''; } )

claim: nixosTest (also under testers) is 'primarily for external use' and is mostly equivalent to importing make-test-python.nix from the NixOS manual, except the caller's pkgs application is used; if a test machine needs nixpkgs options it must set only nixpkgs.pkgs.
stance_target: Alternative entrypoint if runNixOSTest's read-only nixpkgs.* restriction is a problem
quoted_support: NOTE: This function is primarily for external use. NixOS itself uses make-test-python.nix directly. ... If a test machine needs to set NixOS options under nixpkgs, it must set only the nixpkgs.pkgs option.

claim: The manual's runNixOSTest section itself contains no QEMU display/headless configuration guidance; headless behaviour and interactive testing are documented in the NixOS manual (see nixos-manual-2), not the nixpkgs testers chapter.
stance_target: Whether URL 2 alone answers the headless/interactive wiring question
